speak.title: Role-play: is it just a joke?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You read that mogging began in gyms and online groups that ranked people by looks. Your teenager uses the word all the time. Ask what it means to them. Decide if they can keep using it.

b.text: You use mogging as a joke about dogs, football and photos. Explain why it's harmless. Say what your friends mean by it. Try to keep using it.

phrases: I read where that word comes from.
What do you and your friends mean by it?
It's just a joke, I promise.
I'm not sure it's harmless, though.
Would you say it to someone who wasn't laughing?
Let's agree to be careful with it.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the parent change their mind, and why?
